decks.notes: This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using artifacts. By utilizing cards like Urza's Saga and Mox Opal to ramp up quickly, along with creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Kappa Cannoneer for added pressure, the deck can quickly establish a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Engineered Explosives and Tormod's Crypt help to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck focuses on explosive early plays and maintaining pressure to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Fallaji Archaeologist and Goryo's Vengeance to reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier at instant speed. By using cards like Ephemerate and Otherworldly Gaze, the deck aims to set up explosive plays and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending for interaction and removal. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game through powerful reanimation effects and efficient card draw.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be tutored for using Green Sun's Zenith and Fiend Artisan. These creatures work together to generate mana and create a strong board presence, culminating in a combo finish with Craterhoof Behemoth. Leyline of Abundance and Agatha's Soul Cauldron provide additional synergy with the mana-producing creatures. The toolbox aspect allows for versatility and adaptability against different matchups, while the inclusion of Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler adds an aggressive element to the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance, while also utilizing instant spells like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent. It also includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Quantum Riddler to generate value and slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win the game through a quick and explosive combo that can be difficult for opponents to interact with effectively.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. It also utilizes Sowing Mycospawn and Blade of the Bloodchief to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes various support cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to dominate the game.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's plans through a combination of counter spells, removal, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch, the deck aims to maintain a grip on the game while leveraging powerful utility creatures like Wan Shi Tong, Librarian and Orcish Bowmasters to further dominate the board. With a mix of powerful control spells and versatile creatures, this Dimir Control deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through strategic play and resource management.

This deck focuses on utilizing instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand into play early in the game. By combining this with cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending for card advantage, as well as controlling the board with removal spells like Solitude and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to set up a game-winning combo quickly and efficiently. The creatures in the deck, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Psychic Frog, serve as key pieces to the combo and provide additional utility to further the deck's game plan.

The focus of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The deck also utilizes cheap cantrips and pump spells to maintain card advantage and pump up its creatures for quick kills. The mana base is streamlined to maximize consistency and speed. With a low mana curve and aggressive playstyle, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or set up their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with strong abilities to generate value and disruption, while also incorporating powerful combo pieces like Emrakul, the Promised End and Eldrazi Temple. With cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Malevolent Rumble, it aims to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. In addition, it includes search and ramp spells like Ancient Stirrings and Springleaf Drum to ensure consistency and speed in executing its game plan. Overall, the deck strategy revolves around creating a synergistic engine that can quickly dominate the game with a powerful combo finish.

This deck focuses on assembling key combo pieces using creatures as a toolbox, such as Cauldron Familiar for recurring sacrifice value, Chord of Calling for tutoring specific creatures, and Viscera Seer for controlling sacrifices. The deck also includes cards like Birthing Ritual and Gilded Goose to ramp up mana quickly and access powerful spells sooner. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Voice of Victory offer protection and additional win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently combo off while maintaining board control and versatility.

The main concept of this Hollow One Aggro deck is to aggressively play creatures like Hollow One, Marauding Mako, and Detective's Phoenix, while utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting to quickly fill the graveyard and bring out powerful threats. Lightning Bolt and Violent Urge provide removal and reach, while the deck's mana base allows for consistent and fast plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells, taking advantage of the graveyard as a resource for explosive plays.

The deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, counterspells like Force of Negation and Counterspell, and removal spells like Cling to Dust and Consign to Memory. It also utilizes creatures with disruptive abilities like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Wan Shi Tong, Librarian to further control the board. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by controlling the game's pace and utilizing efficient threats like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Orcish Bowmasters while keeping the opponent's resources in check.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to power out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Basking Broodscale. It also utilizes cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up your own board presence. The combination of creatures with abilities that trigger when other creatures die, along with cards like Blade of the Bloodchief, allows for explosive turns where you can overwhelm your opponent with a massive army of creatures.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal, and hand disruption. It aims to control the board and limit the opponent's resources while gradually building card advantage through cards like Quantum Riddler and Wan Shi Tong, Librarian. The deck also utilizes land destruction with Field of Ruin and control win conditions like Sheoldred's Edict. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and control elements, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on using a combination of creatures and spells to search for and put key combo pieces into play quickly. By utilizing Green Sun's Zenith and Leyline of Abundance, players can search for creatures like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Devoted Druid to generate mana and combo off. The toolbox aspect of the deck allows for flexibility in finding the right creatures for the situation, while Malevolent Rumble and Agatha's Soul Cauldron provide additional disruption and removal options. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on quickly using spells like Goryo's Vengeance to bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand or Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard to the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Solitude for protection and disruption, while leveraging Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the opponent's game plan. The strategy involves combining instant reanimation with combo potential, providing a versatile and aggressive approach to outmaneuver opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 setting.
